```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source(here::here("R/publication_artifacts.R"))
begin_artifact_render("figure5")
source(here::here("R/report_setup.R"))
setup_report(
  sources = c("02", "03", "04", "05", "06"),
  funs = c("model_fun", "calculate_outcomes", "cea_helpers", "report_format",
           "psa_functions", "evppi_functions", "scenario_analysis"),
  packages = c("here", "ggplot2", "dplyr", "scales"),
  set_theme = FALSE
)
```

```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
cache_file <- scenario_evppi_path()
if (!file.exists(cache_file)) {
  stop(
    "Full scenario cache not found: ", cache_file, ". Run ",
    "analysis/12_scenario_EVPPIs.R before rendering Figure 5."
  )
}
evppi_cache <- load_scenario_cache(path = cache_file)

# Figure 5 shows joint ([GROUP]) EVPPI rows only. Per-parameter rows are never
# added to group rows: EVPPI is not additive, and summing single-parameter and
# group estimates for the same parameters produced bars above total EVPI in
# earlier versions (issue #152). The interaction bar is the joint EVPPI of all
# treatment-by-biomarker coefficients (interaction_all).
# Unit drug and test prices are fixed in the PSA since issue #154, so there is
# no drug_costs group; the cost bar is the sampled resource-use costs (visits,
# baseline work-up, follow-up contacts, end-of-life care).
figure_groups <- c(
  "[GROUP] other_costs" = "Resource-use costs",
  "[GROUP] utilities" = "Utilities",
  "[GROUP] prevalence" = "Biomarker prevalence",
  "[GROUP] interaction_all" = "Biomarker-treatment interaction"
)

scenario_labels <- c(
  base = "Base case",
  s1_decreased_nivo = "Biosimilar pricing",
  s2_wtp100k = "WTP 100,000"
)

to_population <- function(x) {
  calculate_population_evppi(
    x,
    annual_incidence = annual_incidence_norway,
    research_horizon = research_horizon_years,
    discount_rate = discount_rate_research
  )
}

evppi_all <- compile_evppi_results(evppi_cache$all_scenario_results)
evppi_grouped <- data.frame()
if (nrow(evppi_all) > 0) {
  if (!"evppi_se" %in% names(evppi_all)) evppi_all$evppi_se <- NA_real_

  evppi_grouped <- evppi_all %>%
    filter(scenario_id %in% names(scenario_labels),
           parameter %in% names(figure_groups)) %>%
    mutate(
      param_group = unname(figure_groups[parameter]),
      evppi_pop = to_population(evppi),
      se_pop = to_population(evppi_se),
      evpi_pop = to_population(evpi),
      Scenario = factor(scenario_labels[scenario_id], levels = scenario_labels)
    )


}
```

```{r figure, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
if (nrow(evppi_grouped) > 0) {
  group_order <- evppi_grouped %>%
    group_by(param_group) %>%
    summarise(total = sum(evppi_pop, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(total) %>%
    pull(param_group)

  evppi_grouped$param_group <- factor(evppi_grouped$param_group, levels = group_order)

  p_evppi <- ggplot(evppi_grouped, aes(x = param_group, y = evppi_pop, fill = Scenario)) +
    geom_col(na.rm = TRUE, position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = ifelse(se_pop > 0, evppi_pop - 1.96 * se_pop, NA_real_),
          ymax = ifelse(se_pop > 0, evppi_pop + 1.96 * se_pop, NA_real_)),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.25,
      linewidth = 0.4, colour = "gray30", na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(is.na(evppi_pop), "NA", ifelse(evppi_pop == 0, "0", "")),
                  y = ifelse(is.na(evppi_pop), 0, evppi_pop), colour = Scenario),
              position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), hjust = -0.2, size = 3,
              show.legend = FALSE) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0("EUR ", format(x, big.mark = ","), "M")) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Population EVPPI (EUR millions)",
      fill = "Scenario",
      caption = paste0(
        "Joint EVPPI per parameter group (regression estimator); ",
        "error bars are 95% Monte Carlo intervals.\nGroups are not sums of ",
        "single-parameter EVPPIs. Zero EVPI bounds every group at zero.\nNA denotes a missing or failed estimate."
      )
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

  print(p_evppi)
} else {
  p_evppi <- ggplot() + theme_void() +
    annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0, label = "No scenario EVPPI estimates")
  print(p_evppi)
}
```

```{r evpi-reference}
if (nrow(evppi_grouped) > 0) {
  evppi_grouped %>%
    distinct(Scenario, evpi_pop) %>%
    arrange(Scenario) %>%
    mutate(`Population EVPI` = paste0("EUR ", sprintf("%.2f", evpi_pop), "M")) %>%
    select(Scenario, `Population EVPI`) %>%
    knitr::kable(caption = "Total population EVPI per scenario (upper bound for every bar)")
}
```

```{r failed-estimates}
if (nrow(evppi_grouped) > 0 && any(nzchar(evppi_grouped$error))) {
  evppi_grouped %>% filter(nzchar(error)) %>%
    select(scenario_name, parameter, error) %>% knitr::kable()
}
```

```{r save-figure, include=FALSE}
if (exists("p_evppi")) {
  figs_dir <- here("outputs", "figs")
  if (!dir.exists(figs_dir)) dir.create(figs_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  save_artifact_plot(here("outputs", "figs", "figure5.png"), p_evppi, width = 9, height = 6,
         dpi = 300, bg = "white")
}
```
